title: OO-LD dialect meta-schema
$comment: The $id uses the versioned hosting at oo-ld.org/. The OO-LD vocabulary is declared optional (false) so that generic JSON-Schema 2020-12 validators still process OO-LD schemas. Two-tier structure: this resource is what a schema's $schema points at, so it carries the DOCUMENT-level obligations (required: $id). The dialect body lives in oold-meta-schema-base.json, which holds $dynamicAnchor: "meta"; nested subschemas recurse into the base via the standard $dynamicRef and are therefore NOT required to carry $id.
